item.nosugar.halo.of.sugar.desc: You have reached the Truth. One might even say you have become the Truth. ...Worry not, I require no payment. ...Not that I could take anything from you anymore, at this point. Now then, allow me to introduce myself. I am what you call the 'World.' Or perhaps the Universe, or God, or Truth, or All, or One. And—I am you. So? How did you get your hands on this? ...It doesn't matter now. To wear this is to become the Truth itself. ...Well, if you possess this, I suppose it was only a matter of time... Very well. Take my place... '[TRUTH]'.
